title: Open Worktime submission
description: Client-supplied privacy-minimal payload before server receipt metadata and analysis weight are attached.

country.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 work country. Geography is useful context, not an intake gate.

work_region.description: Optional coarse work region as the contributor knows it, for example Shanghai, Texas, or Berlin. Do not enter a home address or precise private location.

facility_id.description: Canonical Open Worktime facility identifier when resolved.

facility_text.description: Fallback production-site name when unresolved. Must not contain personal identifiers.

work_role.description: Broad work role used only to estimate relevance to ordinary manufacturing labor. Exact job title is intentionally not collected.

high_income_5x.description: Whether total compensation is roughly five times or more than typical local full-time income. No exact salary is collected.
